caption: Figure 5.12 tRNA - the adapter molecule
note: Two tRNA molecules side by side (Ser on the left, Tyr on the right); labels read across each row. The anticodon triplets are U C A (left) and A U G (right); the codon triplets on the mRNA are A G U (left) and U A C (right). Both "tRNA" labels are printed with a leader dash after them ("tRNA —"); dash omitted. Prime marks transcribed as ASCII apostrophes. Crop over-includes one body line above ("as an adapter molecule was assigned much later."), one below ("another specific tRNA that is referred to as initiator tRNA"), and a strip of the neighbouring right-hand text column clipped at the right margin; all excluded.
